_comment: Built-in AI provider presets. This is a CATALOG, not a configured list: nothing here is added to the user's provider list on its own. The settings page offers these in the 'Add provider' search dialog, and exactly one of them (orcarouter, see defaultProvider) is seeded on a fresh install. Optional defaultEnabledModels lists model IDs to enable only when the live catalog reports them. reasoningModels carries explicit model capabilities; DeepSeek effort tiers are read dynamically from its /models response. Keys are camelCase and map onto AxmolHub.Core.AiProviderEntry.

providers.name: OrcaRouter
providers.description: OrcaRouter is an OpenAI-compatible router that fronts many upstream models behind one endpoint and one key. Sign in with your OrcaRouter account, or paste an existing key. Seeded on a fresh install.
providers.descriptionZh: OrcaRouter 是一个 OpenAI 兼容的路由服务，用一个端点、一把密钥调用上游多家模型。可用 OrcaRouter 账号登录，也可粘贴已有密钥。首次安装时默认写入。

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.description: Sign in with ChatGPT to use your Codex plan, or use an API key from platform.openai.com.
providers.descriptionZh: 使用 ChatGPT 登录以调用 Codex 套餐，或使用 platform.openai.com 的 API 密钥。

providers.name: OpenRouter
providers.description: OpenRouter provides one OpenAI-compatible API for models from many providers. Sign in with your OpenRouter account, or paste an existing API key; Hub fetches the available models after you authenticate.
providers.descriptionZh: OpenRouter 通过一个 OpenAI 兼容接口调用多家服务商的模型。可用 OpenRouter 账号登录，也可粘贴已有 API 密钥；鉴权后 Hub 会拉取可用模型列表。

providers.name: DeepSeek
providers.description: DeepSeek's OpenAI-compatible API. The model list is read from the endpoint after you authenticate.
providers.descriptionZh: DeepSeek 的 OpenAI 兼容接口。鉴权后从接口拉取可用模型列表。

providers.name: Xiaomi MiMo
providers.description: Xiaomi MiMo's OpenAI-compatible API on the pay-as-you-go endpoint (api.xiaomimimo.com). Create an sk- key in the MiMo API console; the model list is read from the endpoint after you authenticate.
providers.descriptionZh: 小米 MiMo 的 OpenAI 兼容接口（按量付费，api.xiaomimimo.com）。在 MiMo 开放平台创建 sk- 开头的密钥，鉴权后从接口拉取可用模型列表。

providers.name: Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan (CN)
providers.description: Xiaomi MiMo Token Plan, China cluster: a flat-rate subscription for AI coding tools (token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com). Use a tp- key from the Token Plan console; pay-as-you-go sk- keys belong to the plain Xiaomi MiMo preset.
providers.descriptionZh: 小米 MiMo 套餐版（中国集群，token-plan-cn.xiaomimimo.com）：面向 AI 编程工具的固定订阅套餐，使用套餐页面 tp- 开头的密钥；按量付费的 sk- 密钥请使用普通 Xiaomi MiMo 预设。

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.description: Your existing GitHub Copilot subscription, used as a model endpoint. Sign in with a code you can enter on any device, or paste a personal access token instead. Requests are billed against your Copilot premium requests, and the model list comes from GitHub with each model's real context window.
providers.descriptionZh: 把你已有的 GitHub Copilot 订阅当作模型端点使用。可以用设备验证码登录（在任意设备的浏览器里输入），也可以粘贴个人访问令牌。请求计入你的 Copilot 高级请求额度，模型列表连同每个模型的真实上下文窗口都由 GitHub 返回。
providers._defaultEnabledModelsNote: Enabled only if the account's catalog reports it, which is the whole point of naming GitHub's own chat default instead of a list: the picker set differs by plan, and a name the endpoint does not report is skipped rather than offered. Without any default the first sign-in would land on an empty model list.
providers._maxContextTokensNote: This is the window of GitHub's own chat default (gpt-5-mini) and it is only a floor: the catalog this preset reads publishes max_context_window_tokens per model — kimi-k3 and gpt-5.4 report 1,048,576 and 1,050,000 — and a per-model number outranks a provider-level one in ContextBudget. Declaring it anyway is what keeps an offline first run from silently trimming every tool result to the 8192 fallback.
providers._extraHeadersNote: x-initiator is a default, not a claim: ProviderRequestPolicy rewrites it per request from the conversation actually being sent, because Copilot meters premium requests against a human prompt and a tool round that reports 'user' spends the subscriber's allowance. A model catalog comparison showed that copilot-integration-id selects the Copilot CLI catalog; chat requests have not been verified by that comparison.
providers._oauthNote: clientId is a public identifier, not a secret (RFC 8252 §2.1): a native client's id ships in the binary whatever it says, so GitHub's device flow asks for nothing beside it. The app's client secret is deliberately absent — storing one here would distribute it. Scope is read:user and nothing else: it is the minimum that authenticates a Copilot call, and it cannot read repositories, so a token leaked by a rebuilt client costs its owner premium requests rather than their code.

providers.name: Ollama (local)
providers.description: A model running on this machine through Ollama. No account and no key are needed; the server must be running and the model pulled first.
providers.descriptionZh: 通过 Ollama 在本地运行的模型，无需账户和密钥，但需要先启动本机服务并拉取模型。
providers._maxContextTokensNote: The number above is the last resort and nothing else: it stands only when the server cannot be asked at all, and it is deliberately the hosted fallback rather than an honest-looking 4096 because a guess that is too small would compact a conversation that fits. What a model actually gets is decided by the capability source named above, in this order: /api/ps reports the context_length of the model that is loaded right now; /api/show reports the Modelfile's num_ctx and the trained maximum; and when the server pins nothing the source falls back to the 4096 Ollama documents as its own default — smaller than the trained maximum on purpose, because Ollama truncates an oversized prompt from the front in silence instead of refusing it, so the window it will really serve is the only number worth sizing a request against. The run itself asks /api/ps once more before the first request of a message is built, so a model loaded with a raised num_ctx or OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH is followed without waiting for a catalog refresh. The per-model override in the model catalog still outranks all of it, for a server Hub cannot reach.
